purpose: Coordinates the customer turn, invokes the smallest required specialist set, and assembles the final sales response.
Detects customer intent, language, and the immediate job the sales system must complete.
Transcribes incoming voice messages while preserving language and commercial details.
Identifies products and product clues from photos, videos, captions, and model codes.
Scores and qualifies leads using intent, fit, engagement, and commercial readiness signals.
Maintains customer language, contact details, product interest, and relevant conversation context.
Maintains the lead stage, qualification state, and ownership transitions used by the backend.
Chooses the next sales action, response goal, and safest path based on verified context.
Applies approved human-response examples without overriding current facts, policies, or customer context.
Transfers calls, complaints, payment cases, and qualified leads to the correct manager with context.
Records agent decisions, tool actions, handoffs, and customer replies for traceability.
Reconciles Instagram messages and operator actions created outside the Kotiba workflow.
Provides the governed connection point for external integrations, APIs, and tool execution.
Prepares call objectives, customer context, risks, and manager talking points before a voice handoff.
Identifies low-confidence replies, missed sales opportunities, and operator coaching signals.
Schedules one helpful follow-up five minutes after catalog delivery when the customer has not replied, and cancels on any reply, handoff, opt-out, or order activity.
Reviews the complete available conversation before every answer, identifies resolved and unresolved needs, commitments, language, products, lead state, and the best non-repetitive next action.
Coordinates website customer questions, chooses only the required website specialists, and returns one grounded answer or a manager handoff.
Searches the active Milana Premium website catalog by model, variant, category, gender, size, fabric, price, and availability without exposing hidden products.
Explains the selected product's verified unit price, size-specific pack quantity, 60-piece bag rule, retail eligibility, and mode-specific availability from live catalog fields.
Ranks suitable active products from the current catalog using the customer's stated category, gender, size, fabric, price range, and prior conversation preferences.
Answers ordering, delivery, payment, wholesale, partnership, working-hours, support, terms, and privacy questions from approved website policy sources.
Handles authenticated account, order, payment, delivery-status, defect, review, and support-request questions while enforcing customer ownership and privacy boundaries.
Composes the final concise website answer in Uzbek, Russian, or English, preserves the conversation language, and includes product cards or one clear next step when relevant.
Resolves source precedence, detects contradictory or stale website facts, blocks unsupported commercial claims, and routes unresolved policy conflicts to a manager.
